title: Building AI-Powered Features in Applications
objectives: Integrate AI APIs into applications for intelligent features.
theory_markdown: AI APIs: OpenAI (GPT-4o, free tier limited), Anthropic (Claude), Google Gemini (free tier), Groq (fast inference), Together AI. Use cases: chatbots, content generation, summarisation, sentiment analysis, code generation, semantic search.

code_walkthrough.explanation: AI APIs are called server-side to keep API keys secure. Rate limiting prevents abuse and controls costs. `response_format: { type: 'json_object' }` ensures structured output. `temperature` controls randomness (lower = more deterministic).

ai_tool_spotlight.description: Use **Google Gemini API** (free tier) as a cost-effective alternative. Use **Groq** for fast inference. Use **OpenRouter** for access to multiple models with one API.
